# `assets/humanoid/BoneMapper.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/humanoid/BoneMapper.js`

engine/assets/humanoid/BoneMapper.js — map a source skeleton's bones onto the canonical humanoid slots (HumanoidRig) by NAME first (Mixamo / VRM / generic rig conventions), then hierarchy for the spine chain. Every mapping is a hint; ambiguous/extra bones are reported as `unmapped` and missing required slots as `missing` so the editor can correct (rule 62). Pure + GPU-free (gate-testable).

## Functions

### `mapBones(model, opts = {})`

Map a model's skeleton to canonical humanoid bones.

**Parameters:**

- `model` *(object)* — EngineModel
- `[opts]` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** }
